verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim is documented as running on your own infrastructure. The docs cover a Docker container setup, pip/conda installation, building your own wheels from source, and headless operation from workstation to data center. Isaac Lab is described as open source, and the community notes GR00T N1 was released under Apache 2. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting docs (hardware requirements, licensing terms for Isaac Sim itself, air-gapped setup) and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
